# Software Version Document
This document lists the baseline software versions for the current environment and related support items.

## Purpose
The purpose of this document is to provide a quick reference for installed software versions, support status, and compatibility assumptions.

## Current Software Inventory

| Component | Version | Status | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Operating System | Windows 11 Pro | Active | Primary user environment |
| Quarto | 1.11.9 | Active | Used for document generation |
| Typst | Current project default | Active | Used for PDF rendering |
| Visual Studio Code | Current installed version | Active | Primary authoring environment |
| Git | Current installed version | Active | Source control |

## Compatibility Notes
- Quarto should be used from the project root to keep relative file references stable.
- Typst is the supported rendering engine for generated PDFs.
- Any document-specific metadata should remain project-scoped and consistent with the shared asset files.

## Version Control Summary
- All project files should be tracked in source control.
- Updates to software versions should be recorded in this document when the environment changes.

## Approvals
This document is intended as a working reference and should be reviewed whenever tooling or environment versions change.
